sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A filamentous freshwater green alga of northern temperate regions. It grows attached, as loose filaments or mats, and—under particular lake conditions—as spherical marimo. Large balls can exceed 20 cm in diameter. It has no roots, leaves, flowers or seeds.

sections.title: Food and safety
sections.text: The sources consulted do not establish this alga as edible.
